from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title and Lecture Lines
        lines = [
            'Prime distribution directly dictates the value of pi.',
            'Algebraic sorting machines construct the most fundamental constant.',
            'Geometry emerges from the rhythm of prime remainders.',
            'From infinite tracks to the perfect symmetry of circles.',
            'The secret rhythm of primes defines our mathematical universe.'
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Synthesis: Order from Prime Chaos", lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_1 = YELLOW
        COLOR_2 = GREEN
        COLOR_3 = CYAN
        COLOR_4 = "#FF00FF" # Glowing Pi

        self.place_at_grid(bucket_2, "E2", scale_factor=1.0)

            run_time=2

        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_2)
        
        # Overlapping/Moving them into a construction area
        construction_area = VGroup(bucket_1, bucket_2, track_1, track_2)
        self.play(
            construction_area.animate.move_to(self.grid["D4"]),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_3)
        
        # Prepare Pi components

        pi_top = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=0.2, width=3.0, color=COLOR_4, fill_opacity=0.8)

        pi_leg_l.shift(RIGHT * 0.5) 
        
        # Right leg
        pi_leg_r = RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.1, height=1.5, width=0.2, color=COLOR_4, fill_opacity=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(pi_leg_r, "D5", scale_factor=1.0)
        pi_leg_r.shift(LEFT * 0.5)

        pi_group = VGroup(pi_top, pi_leg_l, pi_leg_r)

        # Morph Animation
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(track_1, pi_top),
            ReplacementTransform(track_2, pi_leg_l),
            ReplacementTransform(bucket_1, pi_leg_r),
            FadeOut(bucket_2),
            run_time=2
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_4)
        
        # Add a glow effect (simple scale pulses)

            pi_group.animate.scale(1.1).set_color(COLOR_4),

        self.play(
            pi_group.animate.scale(1/1.1),
